data: You emit an ear-shattering high pitched sound that only your target can hear, leaving them in a defenseless state. When activating this move, a target must make a {save}. On a failure, all attack rolls against the target are given a +5 bonus until the end of your next turn.
Badly startles all of the other Pokémon to act before the user.
All Pokemon that acted before the user must make CHA Saving Throws against Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
